description: A complete Android Activity class 'ContentInfoActivity' that displays detailed media content information with multiple UI elements including texts, images, and action buttons. The class handles view initialization, content population, focus behavior, and user interactions. It also provides a companion object with a method to create intents passing media metadata.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class for displaying detailed media content info with focus and interaction handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, views, populates content, and sets up focus and button behaviors.

methods.name: initializeViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns views from layout by ID.

methods.name: populateContent
methods.description: Defines content data (mostly defaulted) and populates UI elements, including setting a background image and text fields.

methods.name: setupFocusBehavior
methods.description: Sets focus change animations for buttons and defines initial focus.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Sets click listeners for all action buttons.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back button press to finish activity.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Static method to generate an Intent for launching this activity with specified media item metadata.
